integrationMethods.gold: split at every crossed WS1 LUT cell boundary, expand the trilinear basis into exponentials, and integrate each term analytically
integrationMethods.runtimeDouble: composite two-point Gauss-Legendre; 32 panels per native-frame duration
integrationMethods.futureShaderFloat32: independent binary32 transcription of the same fixed quadrature contract

limits: The float32 path is a future-Shader arithmetic contract, not compiled GPU readback. Actual GPU validation remains WS8/WS9.
